source.url: local file supplied by the user (a saved TikTok)

hook.mechanism: Opens on the speaker mid-sentence, then restates the key question as a full-screen text card at 1.3 s
hook.visual: Close framing, first word on screen at 0.0 s, white card with a red question mark from 1.3 s to 3.5 s

captions.position: floating beside and below the face (left, right, chest, above the head); never a fixed bar
captions.emphasis: one large bold word per idea; small words in italic serif; no colour emphasis
captions.animation: each word blurs in on its spoken time (about 0.25 s) and stacks; the stack clears at the cut
captions.font_like: tight geometric sans SemiBold/Bold + high-contrast italic serif (licensed match used: Poppins + Playfair Display Italic, SIL OFL)

layout.framing: chest-up to tight face, jumping between three zoom levels at cuts
graphics: full-screen white text card with one red glyph

transitions.kind: hard cut after a two-frame red flash

music.replacement: none: effects only, no music bed
music.note: The bed is audible for only 15% of the clip, so bpm, genre, mood and rel_lu describe a few moments, not a continuous track. The user chose effects only on 2026-11-16 without confirming the genre or mood guess.

sfx_rules.event: cut into a text card or cutaway
sfx_rules.evidence: 1 bright whoosh at 4.48 s, 0.11 s after the cut to B-roll
short click at 3.62 s after the card; a bassy thump at 8.22 s after the B-roll (kit has no close match for the thump)
bassy ringing sound at 15.63 s on the end card; in the kit build the brand outro's own cues play instead
no effect detected on any word entrance; quiet effects under speech can be missed

mix.note: The kit masters to -16 LUFS; the reference level was not copied.

brand_policy: reference-wins for fonts, colours and captions; brand keeps the outro card; no bumper, no lower-third (user decision 2026-11-16)
does_not_transfer: The creator's footage, script and B-roll
The platform watermark and end card
